# EY Canada

> EY Canada provides consulting, assurance, tax, strategy and transaction services to help organizations solve complex challenges and shape the future with confidence.

EY serves Canadian organizations with services spanning strategy, consulting, technology, sustainability, tax, assurance and transactions, alongside research, economic analysis and industry insights.

## Core Services
- [Services](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services): Overview of EY Canada service lines across consulting, tax, assurance, strategy and transactions.
- [Consulting](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/consulting): Business transformation consulting covering operations, customer, workforce and enterprise change.
- [Technology](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/technology): Technology services focused on modernization, platforms, data, AI and digital transformation.
- [Cybersecurity consulting services](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/cybersecurity): Cybersecurity strategy, risk, resilience and managed security consulting services.
- [Sustainability](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/sustainability): Sustainability and ESG services for decarbonization, reporting, strategy and value creation.
- [Long-term value](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/long-term-value): Services and perspectives on measuring and delivering long-term stakeholder value.

## Strategy by EY-Parthenon
- [Strategy by EY-Parthenon](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/parthenon): Strategy, transactions and transformation services for growth, value creation and portfolio decisions.
- [Strategy Consulting](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/consulting): Strategy consulting services for enterprise growth, transformation and competitive positioning.
- [Corporate Strategy](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/corporate-growth-strategy): Corporate and growth strategy services for portfolio, market and investment choices.
- [Transaction Strategy and Execution](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/transaction-strategy-execution): Deal strategy and execution support across acquisitions, divestitures and integrations.
- [Commercial Strategy](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/commercial-strategy-consulting): Commercial strategy consulting focused on growth, pricing, sales and customer economics.
- [Turnaround and Restructuring Consulting](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/restructuring-turnaround-strategy): Restructuring and turnaround support for liquidity, performance improvement and stakeholder management.
- [Industry Strategy](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/industry-strategy): Sector-informed strategy services tailored to industry dynamics and disruption.

## Insights and Research
- [Insights](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/insights): EY Canada insights hub for articles, reports, analysis and thought leadership.
- [Trust](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/insights/trust): Insights on trust, risk, governance, transparency and stakeholder confidence.
- [Purpose](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/insights/purpose): Perspectives on purpose-led transformation, leadership and organizational impact.
- [Transformation Realized™](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/transformation-realized): Research and case studies on successful transformation and value realization.
- [Economic Advisory](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/economics): Economic analysis, forecasts and policy perspectives from EY Canada economists.

## Sustainability and Long-Term Value
- [Sustainability](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/sustainability): Advisory services for sustainability strategy, decarbonization and ESG transformation.
- [Long-term value](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/long-term-value): Frameworks and services for measuring value beyond short-term financial outcomes.
- [Transformation Realized™](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/transformation-realized): Evidence-based transformation content connecting change programs to measurable business outcomes.
- [Purpose](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/insights/purpose): Insight collection on purpose, stakeholder expectations and sustainable business leadership.
- [Trust](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/insights/trust): Content on building trust through governance, reporting, resilience and responsible action.

- [Consulting](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/consulting): Consulting services supporting enterprise transformation, operating models and performance improvement.

- [Cybersecurity consulting services](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/cybersecurity): Security consulting for cyber risk management, resilience and regulatory readiness.
- [Transformation Realized™](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/transformation-realized): Transformation-focused research, examples and practical guidance for change leaders.

## Economics and Market Analysis
- [Economic Advisory](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/economics): Canadian economic forecasts, commentary and advisory services for policy and business planning.
- [Insights](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/insights): Broader thought leadership covering markets, industries, regulation and business trends.
- [Strategy by EY-Parthenon](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/parthenon): Strategy and transaction capabilities informed by market, sector and economic analysis.
- [Corporate Strategy](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/corporate-growth-strategy): Strategy services for growth planning amid changing economic and competitive conditions.

## Transactions, Restructuring and Special Situations
- [Transaction Strategy and Execution](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/transaction-strategy-execution): Support for transaction planning, diligence, execution and post-deal value capture.
- [Turnaround and Restructuring Consulting](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/restructuring-turnaround-strategy): Advisory for distressed situations, restructuring options and turnaround execution.
- [Current insolvency assignments](https://documentcentre.ey.com/): EY document centre listing current insolvency and court-related assignments.
- [Strategy by EY-Parthenon](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/parthenon): Integrated strategy and transaction services for deals, portfolios and transformation.
- [Commercial Strategy](https://www.ey.com/en_ca/services/strategy/commercial-strategy-consulting): Commercial due diligence and growth-oriented strategy support for transactions.
